name: CaseStatement
docs:
A `CASE` statement.

Examples:
```sql
CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1)
        THEN SELECT 1 FROM T;
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 2)
        THEN SELECT 1 FROM U;
    ELSE
        SELECT 1 FROM V;
END CASE;
```
